changes.title: Saved empty-text filters
changes.text: Saved queries now retain an empty text value instead of losing that filter operand.

changes.title: Saved-query compatibility checks
changes.text: Added checks for empty and escaped values, legacy filters, invalid counts and saved-view file round trips.

changes.title: Verified delivery records
changes.text: Recorded TEST89's actual APK publication and the next saved-query integrity checks.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I found an ambiguity when saving a filter with an empty text value. The fix keeps that value distinct while preserving older saved queries.
